_comment: Example hook configuration for Claude Code (or any compatible harness). Drop this into your harness's settings file (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json or equivalent) and adapt paths to where you installed parseprompt. Defaults assume PARSEPROMPT_ROOT=$HOME/.parseprompt.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Classifies intent, queries routing.db, writes prompt_classifications row + .context/todos.md if intent=backlog

PreToolUse._comment: Blocks Write/Edit until parse-prompt has run for this turn
Advisory reminder when editing routing-infrastructure files

Stop._comment: Updates capability keyword weights based on which capabilities were actually invoked. Silently no-ops if SESSION_DB_PATH is unset.
